The competition began on 15 September 2013 and ended on May 13, 2014. The defending champions from the previous season were [[Club Sportif Sfaxien]]. In the 2013-14 league season, Club Africain drew the highest average home attendance with 9,000, followed by ES Tunis with 8,273.{{cite web| url = https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co1158/|
